scope: Merge document correction into the actual dirty main worktree only after isolated experiments; keep other local work uncommitted.
strategy: Preserve the main worktree baseline/reviewer/publication improvements; merge missing document copy guard, disabled style-rule behavior, host failure containment, scoped business tool policy, configurable budgets and document benchmark fixtures. Do not overwrite the newer main reviewer with the older document branch version.

experimentArms.baseline: Frozen actual main working tree, with shared measurement harness only; no copyFrom capability enabled.
experimentArms.candidate: Same frozen main tree plus resolved document branch; copyFrom explicitly enabled only for copy-contract document tasks.

controls: Same original requirements and four seeded deviations per case
Same actual OpenClaw host, GLM model, provider, business prompt and tool policy
Same independent full-document oracle and actual snapshot hashes
No implementation, Skill correction, Stop or stage metrics in document cases
No driver-written corrected drafts or manual Hook injection
beforeMerge: Run deterministic production artifact counterexamples and clean controls in both arms, explicitly marking the injected semantic-PASS probe as offline
Run representative paired native cases: pytest-7490, django-11087, scikit-learn-11578
Compare success, retained deviations, source-equivalent formatting false alarms, native completion, latency, review rounds and usage when available
acceptance: Candidate introduces no new relevant local test failures relative to baseline
Candidate reduces false passes/false blocks in the fixed counterexample set, with no regression on clean controls
All three candidate paired native cases complete the automatic loop and preserve authoritative sources
No uncontained plugin failure or host crash is observed; resource changes are reported, not assumed to be speedups
mainIntegration: Verify current main files still match the tested snapshot or refresh the candidate against any concurrent edits
Preserve local changes with a recoverable snapshot/stash
Fast-forward only document-feature commits into the requested main branch
Restore the exact experimentally validated merged working tree, leaving unrelated main changes uncommitted
afterMerge: Run the six large requirement cases from the real main worktree with the selected plan
Verify byte hashes, automatic feedback, real model edits, baseline binding, native completion and process cleanup
Record measured gains and any latency or token tradeoffs; do not claim general benchmark scores
